notes: 'Alphabetical Listing' on pdf pp1-7 (3 columns, page number then title), OCR at 300 dpi with per-page column crops, titles cleaned by rule. Printed page = pdfPage + 8 near the front but the offset drifts to +9 later (extra page(s)), so offset is null. Each entry's title was searched in OCR of its pdf page (+-2 pages; top-of-page OCR for first tunes, full-page OCR otherwise): 1068 of 1215 confirmed (conf high); the remaining conf med use the index page number with the local offset from nearby confirmed entries and may be off by one. OCR sometimes dropped hundreds digits in the index; ~20 index numbers were repaired that way. Several tunes per page. No composers in the index. Title typos from OCR possible (e.g. 'Bottie').
